notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Added loadout point limit option to custom servers.
Added perk effect multiplier option to custom servers.
Added a test version of the PvE map.
You can use Shift+Ctrl+S to take out enemies.

notes.title: The Future of QUICAL
notes.content:
It has been five days since the release of this game, and we have not been able to secure enough sales to allow constant matching for this game.
If we continue to develop the game as a Battrola game, there is no way we can expect the number of players to naturally increase in the future.
However, we feel that it would be a shame to let this game go on like this.
Therefore, our future goal is to add content that can be played by a single player or a small group of players, and to create a comfortable playing environment that does not require a large number of simultaneous players.
We hope that you will continue to support QUICAL's development.

Update 1.0.1

notes.title: QUICAL will be released soon!
notes.content:
Starting from Open Alpha, to Crowdfunding, to Closed Beta, and now to Open Beta
QUICAL has been supported by the community and has gone through countless updates and bug fixes.

And now, at long last, this game will be released!
On the 23rd of February (if nothing else happens) this game will be released!
Please keep us posted!

Reduced the volume of BGM in the default state.
Added hit detection for trees.
Eliminating trees and rocks sinking into the house.

In order to prevent population divergence, the available regions have been changed only for Japan, the United States and Melbourne.

The park relationship has changed significantly.

I borrowed the points consumed by the squatting speed park.

I borrowed the points consumed by the running speed park.
I waited for the points to be consumed in the jumping power increase park.

Wait for the point of consumption of the reload speed increase park.

I borrowed the points consumed by the maximum health park.
